text:
Amy C.: Quick sync — I'm opening a docs PR to deprecate legacy model variants in the quickstart and replace examples with the new aurora-lite and zephyr-mini paths. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 Please review for compatibility notes + SDK snippet updates. cc @Jordan M. @Vikram S.

Jordan M.: Thanks, Amy. Do we have benchmark numbers to justify changing default snippets? Need to avoid regressions.

Vikram S.: I can paste the 1k-token perf numbers. For aurora-lite (v2) we see ~24ms/token avg on p4; zephyr-mini quantized is ~18ms/token but has some edge-case decoding variance.

Nate (eng): If we switch quickstart to aurora-lite, we should add a fallback note for customers on Dedicated (older hw). Suggest snippet using model alias + fallbacks, e.g.:
```yaml
model: aurora-lite:v2
fallbacks: [aurora-lite:v1, aurora-lite:cpu-quant]
```

Sara L.: I'll update SDK examples. Do we also update the 'supported models' table in the catalog? I can PR a table change after Amy's main PR merges.

Amy C.: Yes please. Also need a short paragraph about sequence length limits (aurora-lite 2048, zephyr-mini 4096). My PR currently has a TODO.

Jordan M.: Ping @Vikram S. for the exact sequence numbers + any caveats (truncation behavior).

Vikram S.: aurora-lite v2: seq_limit=2048, behaviour=truncate + warning header; zephyr-mini: seq_limit=4096, but embeddings longer than 1024 require sharding. Added bench links: https://bench.redwood/aurora-lite-v2

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR 4123 ✅

Sara L.: :thumbsup: I'll push a follow-up PR for the catalog table and update the SDK codeblocks. Plan: 1) merge Amy's PR, 2) small catalog PR, 3) cherry-pick to stable branch.

Nate (eng): One more ask: add a 'migration' note for users pinning model ids; include `model: aurora-lite:v2` example and `fallbacks: [aurora-lite:v1, aurora-lite:cpu-quant]`. Also call out that pinned variants may not be available on older Dedicated pools.

Amy C.: Adding that now. Will also add a short eval note to Redwood Optimize: 'expect slight quality delta vs v1 — see eval results' and link to the eval page.

Jordan M.: LGTM, looks good. @Sara L. can you do a quick run through the SDK snippet lint? We had a broken code fence last time.

Sara L.: On it. I'll add a CI check for snippet formatting and run the examples locally on node/python.

Vikram S.: If anyone needs raw logs from the perf runs, DM me — I can paste csv or share a signed s3 link.

Amy C.: Thanks all — merging after 12:00 PT if no objections. :rocket:
